title: Oceanic Mid-Depth Stratification and Overturning Circulation
exact_target: Explain which processes maintain mid-depth ocean stratification and its overturning circulation.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001529 (OWR-4415-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Theory and Modelling in Atmosphere-Ocean-Science (2010), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2010/34, pp. 2027--2099; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 15--16, printed pages 2041--2042.

status_qualification: The report argues for a mean-versus-eddy overturning mechanism in its specific basin/channel geometry. The title question is a physical mechanism program; no universal inversion or exact circulation formula for every ocean is stated.
